tools.name: ask-gemini
tools.description: Delegate a task to Google Gemini AI agent (uses latest gemini-3.1-pro-preview by default — do NOT set model unless you need a specific older one). Best for: long multi-file operations, complex refactoring, alternative code perspective, tasks needing Gemini's tool ecosystem. Avoid for simple questions or single-file edits the caller can do directly. Supports approval modes, session resume, and sandbox controls.

prompt.description: Task or question for Gemini CLI.

context.description: Background context to prepend to the prompt. Use this to share what you have already tried, relevant findings, file contents, or constraints so Gemini does not repeat work.

model.description: Optional model override. OMIT this parameter to use the latest default model (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Only set if you need a specific older model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite

approvalMode.description: Approval mode: default (prompt), auto_edit, yolo (auto-approve all), plan (read-only)

resume.description: Resume a previous session. Use "latest" for most recent or index number

includeDirs.description: Additional directories to include in the workspace

maxTurns.description: Maximum conversation turns for the session

responseMode.description: Response verbosity: "clean" returns only the final answer (default), "full" returns the complete execution log including thinking, tool calls, and agent activity

tools.name: batch-gemini
tools.description: Run multiple independent tasks via Gemini in parallel. Best for: mass refactoring across files, bulk code transformations, repetitive operations on different targets. Each task runs in its own Gemini process. Set concurrency > 1 for independent tasks. For dependent/sequential tasks, use concurrency=1 or consider a single ask-gemini call instead.

tasks.description: Array of atomic tasks to delegate to Gemini

model.description: Optional model override. OMIT to use the latest default (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Only set for a specific older model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if any task fails

concurrency.description: Number of tasks to run in parallel (1 = sequential, 2-5 = parallel). Use 1 for dependent tasks, higher for independent tasks.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time per task in milliseconds

tools.name: do-act
tools.description: Delegate a complex task to Gemini with optional verification loop. Best tool for: multi-step operations that need automated testing (e.g., "refactor auth and run npm test"). Uses Act-Check-Fix loop: Gemini executes the task, a shell command verifies the result, and on failure Gemini auto-fixes using session resume to preserve context between retries.

command.description: Shell command to verify result (e.g., "npm test", "cargo build")

verify.description: Shell command to validate result. Triggers act-check-fix loop on failure.

maxRetries.description: Max retry attempts if verify fails. Default: 2

model.description: Optional model override. OMIT to use the latest default (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Only set for a specific older model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite

timeout.description: Gemini timeout per attempt in ms. Default: 10min

tools.name: review-changes
tools.description: Get a second opinion on code changes from Gemini (read-only). Best for: reviewing uncommitted work, comparing branches, or auditing specific commits. Runs Gemini in plan mode (no file modifications). Use when you want an independent review perspective from a different AI model.

prompt.description: Custom review instructions or focus areas (cannot be used with uncommitted=true; use base/commit review instead)

uncommitted.description: Review staged, unstaged, and untracked changes (working tree) — cannot be combined with custom prompt

base.description: Review changes against a specific base branch (e.g., "main", "develop")

commit.description: Review the changes introduced by a specific commit SHA

title.description: Optional title to display in the review summary

model.description: Optional model override. OMIT to use the latest default (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Only set for a specific older model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite

tools.name: resume-session
tools.description: Continue a previous Gemini conversation with full context preserved. Use when Gemini already did work and you want follow-up changes without re-explaining the project. Defaults to resuming the latest session; specify index for older ones.

session.description: Session to resume: "latest" for most recent, or index number (e.g., "5")

prompt.description: Follow-up prompt to continue the session with

model.description: Optional model override. OMIT to use the latest default (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Only set for a specific older model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Creative idea generation using Gemini with optional methodology frameworks (SCAMPER, Six Hats, etc.)

prompt.description: The problem or topic to brainstorm about

model.description: Optional model override. OMIT to use the latest default (gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Only set for a specific older model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite

includeAnalysis.description: Include feasibility and impact analysis per idea

tools.name: Help
tools.description: Receive help information about Gemini CLI

tools.name: list-sessions
tools.description: List or delete Gemini CLI sessions for the current project. Uses native gemini --list-sessions / --delete-session.

action.description: Action: list (show sessions), delete (remove a session by index)

sessionIndex.description: Session index to delete (use list first to see available indices)

tools.name: list-skills
tools.description: List discovered Gemini agent skills. Uses native `gemini skills list`.

all.description: Show all skills including disabled ones

tools.name: list-extensions
tools.description: List installed Gemini CLI extensions. Uses native `gemini extensions list`.

tools.name: manage-mcp
tools.description: Manage MCP servers in Gemini CLI: list, add, remove, enable, disable. Uses native `gemini mcp` subcommand.

action.description: Action to perform on MCP servers

commandOrUrl.description: Command or URL for the MCP server (required for add)

args.description: Additional arguments for the MCP server command (for add)

tools.name: manage-extensions
tools.description: Manage Gemini CLI extensions: install, uninstall, update, enable, disable. Uses native `gemini extensions` subcommand.

action.description: Action: install, uninstall, update, enable, disable

source.description: Git repository URL or local path (required for install)

names.description: Extension name(s) (required for uninstall/enable/disable, optional for update)

tools.name: manage-skills
tools.description: Manage Gemini agent skills: install, uninstall, enable, disable, link. Uses native `gemini skills` subcommand.

action.description: Action: install, uninstall, enable, disable, link

source.description: Git repository URL or local path (required for install/link)

scope.description: Scope for the action (project or global)

path.description: Path within the repository for install

tools.name: abort-gemini
tools.description: Kill all running Gemini CLI child processes. Use when a long-running task (e.g., do-act with retries) needs to be stopped immediately.
